_comment: History of alerts already sent, used to dedupe and give the monitor context on what's already been reported.

alerts.headline: NVIDIA reportedly exploring $20B stake in AI data provider Mercor; involved in OpenAI's Ohio data center project; holds $21B stake in SpaceX
alerts.summary: Multiple reports today describe NVIDIA in talks for a roughly $20B stake in AI data-labeling firm Mercor, alongside its existing involvement in OpenAI's Ohio data center buildout and a previously disclosed $21B stake in SpaceX. These are strategic capital-allocation moves rather than confirmed deals in the Mercor case.
alerts.why_it_matters: Large potential capital commitments and deepening ties across the AI/compute ecosystem — relevant to NVDA's strategic positioning and balance sheet deployment, though the Mercor stake is still at the 'exploring' stage, not confirmed.

alerts.headline: AMD launches $5B debt offering to fund AI and data-center capacity
alerts.summary: AMD priced a $5 billion debt offering aimed at expanding AI and data-center infrastructure investment, alongside launching its 'Instinct Coder' enterprise AI product.
alerts.why_it_matters: A material capital raise signals AMD is scaling up AI/data-center investment meaningfully — worth tracking for dilution/leverage implications and execution against that spend.

alerts.headline: Broadcom shares fall ~5% after Marvell lands custom AI chip deal with Google
alerts.summary: AVGO dropped roughly 5% intraday after competitor Marvell Technology announced a deal to develop custom AI chips for Google, raising competitive concerns in Broadcom's custom-silicon business despite Broadcom's own recent strong AI revenue growth (Q2 AI semiconductor revenue up 143% YoY).
alerts.why_it_matters: A direct competitor winning a major customer (Google) in AVGO's core custom AI silicon business is a specific competitive threat with an identifiable market reaction, not routine noise.

alerts.headline: Micron drops 7% after Cathie Wood (ARK Invest) warns high-bandwidth memory prices face cyclical risk
alerts.summary: MU fell about 7% following public comments from ARK Invest's Cathie Wood cautioning that soaring memory prices are a cyclical warning sign rather than a sustainable investment opportunity, and that she is avoiding memory-dependent AI chip stocks. Shares partially rebounded (~1%) in the following premarket session.
alerts.why_it_matters: A large, single-day price move (7%) tied to a specific, named, influential public statement about the durability of Micron's core memory pricing cycle — directly relevant to the investment thesis on MU.

alerts.headline: AMD acquires Taalas to advance AI inference compute solutions
alerts.summary: AMD announced the acquisition of Taalas, aimed at strengthening its compute solutions for the rapidly growing AI inference market. AMD also appointed Tim Ryan to its Board of Directors the same day (Aug 19).
alerts.why_it_matters: A direct M&A move expanding AMD's AI inference capabilities — relevant to its competitive positioning against NVDA in the AI compute market.

alerts.headline: Actively-exploited VMware vCenter security flaw affecting hundreds of systems (VMware is Broadcom-owned)
alerts.summary: Security researchers report a serious VMware vCenter vulnerability being actively exploited, with compromised systems identified across 361 IP addresses in 47 countries. VMware is owned by Broadcom following its 2023 acquisition.
alerts.why_it_matters: A widely-exploited security flaw in a core Broadcom-owned enterprise product is a reputational and potential liability event, distinct from the earlier Marvell/Google competitive story.

alerts.headline: AMD refreshes board leadership to support AI strategy
alerts.summary: AMD announced a board leadership refresh explicitly framed around supporting its AI strategy, reported roughly 3 hours before this check — the freshest AMD item found so far. Specific personnel/role details were not confirmed in search results.
alerts.why_it_matters: A board leadership change tied explicitly to strategic direction is a governance-relevant event; logged despite limited detail because of its clear recency and framing.

alerts.headline: Analysts split after Broadcom selloff: Macquarie downgrades to Neutral, Jefferies raises target to $550, Wells Fargo holds $545
alerts.summary: Following the Marvell/Google-driven selloff, sell-side reaction was mixed: Macquarie downgraded AVGO to Neutral, while Jefferies raised its price target to $550 and Wells Fargo maintained $545. Street commentary broadly framed the move as a 'catalyst gap, not an AI demand collapse.'
alerts.why_it_matters: A major bank (Macquarie) downgrading the stock is a new, distinct rating action beyond the original competitive-threat story — worth tracking as analyst sentiment splits.

alerts.headline: Netlist files new ITC and federal court patent infringement actions against Micron over DDR5 RDIMM/MRDIMM tech
alerts.summary: Netlist filed new patent infringement actions with the ITC and in federal court, accusing Micron of infringing multiple patents related to DDR5 RDIMMs and MRDIMMs — products central to Micron's memory business.
alerts.why_it_matters: An ITC action carries potential import-ban risk on the accused products; a legal action explicitly tied to Micron's core DDR5 memory lineup is a material regulatory/legal risk, distinct from the earlier Cathie Wood price-driven story.
